authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: the integer part of the sub-picture records grouping positions {4}, and the grouping is regular — G=4 divides every one of them and "every position in the integer part of the sub-picture that is a positive integer multiple of G is occupied by a grouping-separator" — so the sequence "contains all integer multiples of G as far as necessary to accommodate the largest possible number" and the extrapolated positions 8, 12, … are used as well. 4.7.5 then inserts a separator "immediately after that digit that appears in the integer part of the number and has N digits between it and the decimal-separator character, if there is such a digit".
